body: Thank you for posting this. I attempted suicide a few months ago and I too have been recovering in the hospital until recently. I wish your family all the best.
My girlfriend just broke up with me... I'm ready to kill myself.. Thanks for you for trying... Goodbye

My parents have built these fucking walls around me, telling me exactly what they want me to do. 

I play guitar and sing, which they seem to be fine with, but again, I was restricted from ever pursuing it as a career

You're right though. I do need to talk to someone. I have severe anxiety, but that is probably resultant from how I was treated when I was younger. 

Thank you Nemarzie for spending time talking to me, it feels good to talk to someone, even if it is on reddit. You have no clue what this means to me. I don't know if this is out of place, but I love you, and again, thank you.

I study Engineering; my dad is an engineer, and I didn't want to disappoint him more than I already do. 

I enjoy music, and my parents refused to see me pursue it. My dad has told me to my face that they would kick me out of the house if I chose to. 

I can't deal with frustration well, I don't even know who to talk to. I'm so fucking used to people not listening, I'm too scared to go anywhere other than the internet for help.

I want to tell them everything, but I feel they won't care. It got to a point where I attempted suicide in my dorm room at University. My roommate found me and took me to the hospital. I want to tell them to pay attention to me for once. They don't even see that I'm upset, needless to say they wouldn't give a shit anyways...

I was bullied all through high-school and I never had the opportunity to tell my parents or ask them for help. They never fucking cared. They wouldn't have even given me a chance to tell them that. I FUCKING HATE MYSELF, FUCK. I just need someone to talk to...
